partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester — the single best profile in this niche. It is a ~8-person, founder-led boutique CPA firm with a dedicated startups practice, it already monetizes GRC-platform alignment (discounts for Vanta/Drata users), and — uniquely — it has a named Co-Founder whose entire job is partnerships (Michael Skiles). A LoxeAI referral arrangement mirrors a motion they already run with Vanta/Drata: auditor validates the tool, then routes pre-audit startup clients to it. Their 'speed, simplicity, cost' positioning for early-stage AWS-native teams matches LoxeAI's readiness-scan value prop exactly.
pitch_note: Reach out to Michael Skiles (Co-Founder & Head of Partnerships): 'You already give discounts to startups on Vanta and Drata because clean evidence makes your audits faster — LoxeAI does the same thing one step earlier, for AWS-native teams that aren't audit-ready yet.' Ask for a 30-minute call where his audit team runs a LoxeAI scan against a sandbox AWS account and pokes holes in the findings as auditors. If it holds up, Constellation tells pre-audit startup leads 'run this scan first — it gets you 80% ready,' turning their not-yet-ready pipeline into faster, cheaper engagements they can close sooner.
